propositions: The tests overlay is not selected when a change adds product declarations but no test files, leaving coverage gaps unflagged except by reviewer discretion

A diff-based detector must fire the tests overlay when an added line matches a declaration pattern (def/class/func/function) whose name is not also removed in the same file, and no changed file matches the tests globs
The detector must be language and layout agnostic, operating on the composed diff context and reusing the existing polyglot _REMOVED_DECL_RE, with no src/**-specific or Python-only assumptions

Guard (vii) in code-review-tests.md must narrow blocking eligibility to coverage gaps concerning newly-introduced behaviour (added lines in the diff) with a named violating input, leaving pre-existing code paths advisory
A move operation (delete in A + add in B) must trigger the overlay, while annotation-only rewrites (added lines whose declared names are also removed in the same file) must not

Anonymous declarations and docs/config-only changes must not trigger the overlay; the negative half of the rule must be keyed on changed_files, not the truncated diff, to remain trigger-proof against DIFF_CHAR_CAP truncation
